scope: Episode 01 visible runtime props first, then Section 0 Field Guide items
governing_rule: No image generation or final promotion before Korean-site product/assembly verification.

sources.title: 산업안전보건기준에 관한 규칙 제11조 작업장의 출입구
산업안전보건기준에 관한 규칙 제21조 통로의 조명

site_gate.verified: Current Korean apartment construction examples repeatedly show a full-height temporary hoarding wall with a wide vehicle gate and a separate adjacent worker/pedestrian entrance or safety passage. The exact portal, booth and access-control hardware are site-specific.
site_gate.legal_basis: 산업안전보건기준에 관한 규칙 제11조: when the primary entrance is for loading/transport machinery, a separate adjacent pedestrian entrance is required.

selected_episode01_visual_family.vehicle_gate: wide rectangular opening in temporary steel-panel hoarding, sized for dump/pump/truck entry
selected_episode01_visual_family.pedestrian_gate: separate narrow worker entrance immediately beside the vehicle gate
selected_episode01_visual_family.control: small guard/access-control booth or access-control post beside pedestrian entrance
selected_episode01_visual_family.separation: physical fence/rail or curb/line treatment keeps worker entry distinct from vehicle throat
selected_episode01_visual_family.signage: NEW PSI / fictional site only; no real constructor logos
selected_episode01_visual_family.road_context: construction access road with cones/bollards only where useful; no decorative clutter

render_contract.composition: one transparent cutout assembly showing vehicle portal + adjacent worker gate + small access-control booth
render_contract.materials: gray/white temporary steel hoarding panels and dark steel portal frame
render_contract.pedestrian_entry: clearly narrower and physically separate from vehicle opening
render_contract.worker_access: walkable threshold, no turnstile unless specifically authored later
render_contract.branding: NEW PSI or NEW PSI CONSTRUCTION only, otherwise blank
render_contract.text: no dense baked instructional text; a small GATE 1 / NEW PSI mark is optional
render_contract.camera: slight three-quarter front, readable vehicle and pedestrian openings simultaneously
render_contract.condition: active Korean apartment construction site, mildly weathered, not showroom-clean

reject: single vehicle opening with workers forced through the same throat
foreign stadium turnstile as the main visual
decorative security gate unrelated to construction hoarding
evidence: Korean current-site photos show large vehicle portals integrated into temporary hoarding and adjacent worker safety entrances/access-control rooms.
Ministry legal interpretation confirms the pedestrian entrance requirement is based on the primary use of the loading/transport entrance, not merely its size.

accepted: wide vehicle portal integrated with temporary hoarding
physical separation between worker and vehicle entries
limitations: finish is cleaner and more architectural than many active apartment sites; runtime grade should reduce showroom-like neatness
turnstile/access hardware remains site-specific and must not be treated as a universal Korean requirement

story_basis: Episode 01 identifies Kang Taesik as the formwork foreman.
When workers are diverted to clear the passage, the authored result explicitly says formwork cleanup slows.
Therefore the reusable Episode 01 material stack should visually read as formwork material cleanup, not as an arbitrary rebar pile.

selected_visual_family.panel_family: Korean Euroform steel-frame plywood panels, same size within one bundle
selected_visual_family.typical_reference_size: 600×1200 mm class used as the visual family reference; do not bake dimensions into the image
selected_visual_family.stack_method: horizontal same-spec stack on timber dunnage/sleepers
selected_visual_family.securing: two band/ratchet straps or equivalent visible securing consistent with a tidy site bundle
selected_visual_family.condition: used panels with realistic concrete residue and worn orange/brown/yellow steel frames; not factory-new

material_stack.official_basis: KOSHA reinforced-concrete/formwork guidance lists plywood, timber, Euroform and shoring materials as incoming formwork materials and requires stable storage so materials do not collapse; dismantled formwork materials should be orderly and balanced.

render_contract.object: one compact bundle of same-size used Korean Euroform 6012 panels
render_contract.panel_geometry: 600×1200 class, F-type perimeter/profile, cross-bars dividing the 1200 mm length into four approximately 300 mm bays, standardized side wedge-pin/tie holes
render_contract.orientation: horizontal stack with panel backs/edges readable
render_contract.support: two timber sleepers/dunnage under the bundle
render_contract.securing: two plain steel/PP bands; no large ratchet buckles
render_contract.face: dark coated plywood with realistic wear and light concrete residue
render_contract.frame: yellow/orange steel frame, used but structurally intact

reject: mixed rebar, pipe, lumber and formwork in one decorative pile
different panel sizes mixed in a single bundle
unrestrained leaning panels presented as the normal reference
generic lumber stack that does not read as Korean Euroform

accepted: four-bay cross-bar rhythm consistent with 1200 mm-class panel geometry
simple two-band securing with no oversized ratchet hardware
limitations: side wedge-pin/tie-hole geometry still requires close comparison before final binary registration
candidate is product-family accurate, not an exact manufacturer clone

access_barrier.verified: For Episode 01 use a Korean construction-site movable safety fence family rather than a generic foreign crowd-control barrier.

geometry_lock.base: two black weighted rubber/polymer bases, one near each vertical leg
geometry_lock.visibility_marking: short black-yellow hazard bands on top/bottom rail may be present by product variant
geometry_lock.center_print: omit from reusable game asset even when commercial products print 안전제일

render_contract.frame: silver galvanized round tube, continuous rounded top corners, approximately 25.4–31.8 mm product family
render_contract.feet: two black weighted bases; no fabricated steel A-frame feet
render_contract.infill: plain blue mesh/screen, taut but slightly field-worn
render_contract.condition: real Korean construction-site wear, no severe damage

reject: US/EU pedestrian crowd-control steel barricade with arched feet
water-filled road barrier as the default access fence
readable 안전제일 text baked into reusable runtime art

limitations: grommet/tie details treated as product-family approximation rather than an exact manufacturer copy
final approval still requires transparent WebP, checksum registration and in-game scale review

vehicle_overlap_zone.verified: This is a conflict relationship between vehicle and pedestrian routes, not a standalone piece of equipment.
vehicle_overlap_zone.render_contract: Render as map/scene overlay geometry only; do not image-generate a fictional physical object.
vehicle_overlap_zone.official_basis: KOSHA guidance requires separating construction-equipment routes from worker passages or controlling access/using a signal person where collision risk exists.

exclusion_zone.verified: Exclusion is created by barriers/cones/tape/signage and work control appropriate to the task.
exclusion_zone.render_contract: Compose from verified Korean barrier/cone assets in the scene; no standalone magical exclusion-zone prop.

open_edge.verified: A slab/platform edge or opening requires guardrail/fence/net/cover protection depending on the condition.
open_edge.render_contract: Use a real RC slab-edge scene fragment. Do not render an abstract 'open edge' object.

wet_floor.verified: Wet/slippery condition is a ground state and housekeeping hazard.
wet_floor.render_contract: Use wet concrete/soil surface decal or scene variation, not an isolated 3D item.

harness_unclipped.verified: Use a KCs-certified full-body harness family. Episode 01 may use a twin-Y double-lanyard configuration, but that configuration is not asserted as a universal Korean legal requirement.
harness_unclipped.render_contract: Brand-neutral Korean KCs-style full-body harness; correct D-ring, lanyards/hooks and shock-absorbing component where the selected certified product has them.

official_basis: KOSHA construction guidance states that a safe passage for workers should be installed separately from material-handling/construction-equipment routes and maintained usable.
KOSHA guidance identifies collision risk where a pedestrian-only passage is not separated from equipment routes.

selected_episode01_visual_family.pedestrian_lane: straight worker passage approximately one-person/two-person lane width, clean walking surface
selected_episode01_visual_family.physical_separator: verified Korean blue-mesh movable safety-fence panels on black weighted bases
selected_episode01_visual_family.continuity: at least two connected fence panels so the separation reads as a route, not an isolated barricade
selected_episode01_visual_family.entry: lane opening remains walkable and does not force workers into the vehicle road
selected_episode01_visual_family.marking: simple floor/lane edge marking allowed; no text baked into reusable art

render_contract.composition: one ground-level worker passage beside one ground-level construction vehicle lane, physically separated by 2–3 approved Korean blue-mesh movable fence panels
render_contract.pedestrian_surface: same-level concrete/asphalt or compacted temporary surface with restrained lane-edge marking
render_contract.vehicle_surface: adjacent temporary construction road with tire wear
render_contract.fence_geometry: approved Korean blue-mesh banding fence on black weighted bases
render_contract.optional_elements: small cone at entry only if needed for continuity
prohibited_elements: raised steel deck unless an authored scene specifically needs a bridge/walkway
water-filled road barriers unless specifically authored
people or vehicles baked into the reusable module

reject: painted line only with no physical separation
single cone presented as full separation
magic glowing route overlay as the physical control
covered public sidewalk tunnel when the authored scene is an internal construction access route

accepted: clear visual distinction between pedestrian and vehicle routes
rejected_or_unresolved: raised perforated-deck walkway was invented and is not required by the verified Episode 01 route condition
extra outer guardrail and orange water barriers add unverified control systems and obscure the core separation logic
asset should show one ground-level pedestrian route and one vehicle route separated by the verified fence family, not a compound temporary bridge system
generated_candidate.action: Regenerate only after a simpler Korean internal-site route composition is locked.

temporary_distribution_board.classification: Korean FRP temporary construction distribution board

selected_product_family.enclosure: orange/yellow rectangular FRP cabinet with shallow rain lip/roof
selected_product_family.stand: simple black steel two-leg H-frame stand with flat feet
selected_product_family.indicator: single small red energized indicator on front
selected_product_family.outlets: blue weather-protected industrial outlets mounted on enclosure side; count kept modest
selected_product_family.door: plain closed front door with simple latch/lock provision
selected_product_family.handle: small side handle may be present
selected_product_family.grounding: grounding conductor/terminal may be represented if visually grounded in the selected product family

visual_evidence: Current Korean product listings show orange/yellow FRP temporary boards on simple black steel stands.
Multiple products show blue protected outlets on the sides and a small red energized indicator on the front.
An open-door reference confirms the same enclosure family contains breaker/RCD assemblies internally, but the normal reusable game asset remains closed.

render_contract.enclosure: simple orange/yellow FRP box; no lifting eyes; no heavy molded industrial roof
render_contract.stand: black square-tube two-leg H-stand, no A-frame bracing
render_contract.outlets: 2–4 blue weatherproof side outlets, Korean-market visual family
render_contract.lock: simple latch/lock provision, not an oversized padlock hero detail
render_contract.text: none; no fake warning labels or pseudo-Korean
render_contract.camera: slight front-left or front-right three-quarter view so one outlet side is visible
render_contract.wear: used site condition with light dust/scuffs, not rust-heavy

reject: red large IEC outlet as dominant feature
open breakers/live parts in the normal reference asset

accepted: no lifting eyes and no dominant red industrial connector
limitations: outlet count and exact layout remain product-family specific
no claim that this is a single universal Korean temporary-board configuration

temporary_lighting_pack.classification: installed LED line-bar temporary-lighting scene fragment

observed: bright white linear LED lighting running horizontally through the shoring zone
multiple light segments visually forming a continuous illuminated line
lighting positioned along temporary-work members rather than as a handheld lamp
black power lead/cable visible at some transitions
wet concrete floor and low-light work environment

legal_function: 산업안전보건기준에 관한 규칙 제21조의 통로 조도 기준 충족 여부는 별도 조도계획/측정으로 판단한다.
도감 자산은 현재 현장의 실제 설치형상과 전선·고정 상태를 보여주되, 이미지 자체가 법적 조도충족을 의미하지 않는다.

accepted: multiple white LED line-bar segments read as a continuous installed run
line-bar is physically attached along system-shoring horizontal members
unfinished basement RC and wet-floor context match the user photos
no handheld or tripod lighting is substituted
remaining_gate: final crop must keep LED line-bar mounting relationship readable at game scale
binary registration and in-game scale QA still required

final_render_contract.asset_type: installed scene fragment, not isolated product
final_render_contract.lighting: multiple slim white LED line-bar segments aligned into a continuous horizontal run
final_render_contract.mounting: mounted/tied along the horizontal member line in the system-shoring zone; exact tie/clip geometry follows site photo
final_render_contract.cable: black power cable and joint transitions visible only where supported by the photos
final_render_contract.structure: actual system-shoring density and galvanized members preserved
final_render_contract.environment: unfinished basement RC, concrete column/slab, subdued ambient light, locally wet floor allowed
reject: decorative LED strip floating in space
one impossible infinitely long rigid lamp
lighting attached to invented members not visible in the site reference

temporary_lighting_pack.web_crosscheck_note: Domestic market searches show several products called LED line/bar, but naming is inconsistent and product geometry varies; therefore user site photos override generic product search for the Episode 01 final.

meaning: 작업조건에 맞는 보호구를 필요한 근로자 수 이상으로 지급하고 착용하도록 해야 한다.
지급한 보호구는 상시 점검하고 이상품은 수리·교환하며 청결을 유지해야 한다.
법은 특정 보호구함 외형 하나를 의무형상으로 정하지 않는다.

korean_product_family.selected_reference: freestanding steel PPE cabinet with acrylic front panels
korean_product_family.body: powder-coated steel, yellow or ivory safety-equipment cabinet family
korean_product_family.doors: clear acrylic-front doors or acrylic viewing panels
korean_product_family.note: Selected as Episode 01 representative field equipment, not a universal statutory cabinet shape.

render_contract.composition: one freestanding Korean-style PPE safety cabinet
render_contract.body: plain yellow powder-coated steel rectangular cabinet, flat roof, no lifting lugs
render_contract.door: yellow steel front door or twin doors with modest clear acrylic viewing window(s), simple silver recessed handle/latch
render_contract.condition: serviceable, light construction-site dust and scuffs
render_contract.text: omit readable 안전보호구함 wording from reusable game art

reject: personal locker bank as the main asset
damaged or dirty PPE presented as ready-for-issue stock
fake KCs marks or brand logos

accepted: modest acrylic viewing windows rather than full glass display doors
no roof lifting lugs or fake labels

selected_visual_family.extinguisher: red stored-pressure ABC dry-powder extinguisher, 3.3 kg class as the Episode 01 representative visual family
selected_visual_family.stand: stable floor stand/base suitable for a 3.3 kg class extinguisher
selected_visual_family.placement: upright, immediately accessible, not hidden behind materials

evidence: Korean retail and fire-safety suppliers repeatedly list KFI-verified 3.3 kg ABC powder extinguishers.
Current LH temporary-fire-facility estimating guidance identifies a small extinguisher as 3.3 kg for its construction-site installation examples.

Industrial-safety rules for fire-risk/hot-work contexts require extinguishing means/fire extinguishers in the relevant control scheme; exact count and type depend on applicable fire-safety requirements and site conditions.

render_contract.composition: one red 3.3 kg class ABC powder extinguisher seated upright in a simple stable floor stand
render_contract.cylinder: standard Korean portable extinguisher proportion; glossy red but field-used
render_contract.gauge: small round pressure gauge under the valve assembly
render_contract.hose: one black flexible discharge hose clipped neatly to the cylinder side
render_contract.handle: black/metal lever and safety pin visible
render_contract.stand: simple red or dark floor base/stand; no oversized designer cabinet
render_contract.label: generic small safety label texture only; no legible manufacturer or certification text
render_contract.condition: clean enough for readiness, minor construction-site dust/scuffing

reject: 20 kg wheeled extinguisher as the default FG008 asset
designer office stand that dominates the extinguisher
fire_extinguisher_station.caution: 3.3 kg is the selected Episode 01 visual family, not a universal legal minimum for every construction fire-risk condition.

first_aid_aed.classification: Korean construction-site first-aid point with optional AED module

first_aid.requirement: 사업주는 부상자의 응급처치에 필요한 구급용구를 갖추고, 그 장소와 사용방법을 근로자에게 알려야 한다.

aed.requirement_scope: AED 의무는 법에서 정한 시설·사업장에 적용되며, 모든 건설현장에 일률적으로 적용되는 형식으로 표현하지 않는다.
aed.workplace_example: 보건관리자를 두어야 하는 사업장 중 상시근로자 300명 이상인 사업장

korean_product_crosscheck.evidence: 국내 산업용/건설현장용 응급처치 구급함이 견고한 ABS/PE 케이스 형태로 판매됨
국내 AED 전문 판매처에서 벽걸이형 NT-W1, 스탠드형 NT-S1 및 일반 AED 보관함을 판매

selected_episode01_visual_family.first_aid_box: white or light-gray rugged ABS first-aid box/cabinet with red cross marker, portable or wall-capable
selected_episode01_visual_family.aed_module: separate white/red AED wall cabinet or slim floor stand placed adjacent to first-aid box
selected_episode01_visual_family.relationship: two adjacent emergency-response assets; visually distinct so AED is not mistaken for the first-aid kit itself
selected_episode01_visual_family.legal_message: asset presence does not imply universal AED legal obligation

render_contract.composition: one compact emergency-response station containing a first-aid box and a separate AED cabinet/stand
render_contract.first_aid_box: rugged rectangular ABS/PE case, white/light gray, red cross symbol only, simple handle/latches
render_contract.aed_cabinet: clean white/red vertical cabinet or slim stand with small heart/lightning pictogram; no real manufacturer logo
render_contract.contents: do not display drugs or detailed medical contents outside the box
render_contract.text: minimal; no dense Korean labels or fake certification marks
render_contract.condition: clean, readily accessible, light construction-site dust only

reject: AED merged into the same first-aid box
claim that AED is universally mandatory at every construction site

selected_visual_family.sensor: Korean-market K-200AW/K-200AWN class wireless installation anemometer family
selected_visual_family.sensor_geometry: three-cup rotor on compact black cylindrical sensor body with rigid mounting bracket
selected_visual_family.display: separate weather-resistant digital monitor/display module showing wind-speed numerals
selected_visual_family.mounting: sensor fixed high on a mast/crane/structure; display located at a readable control point
selected_visual_family.network_option: smartphone/network monitoring may exist in product family but is not baked into the reusable art

product_evidence: K-200AW is currently sold in Korea as a domestically made wireless tower-crane/site anemometer with two monitors.
K-200AWN is currently sold as a domestically made network version with smartphone monitoring.
WTF-B500D is sold domestically as a construction-site/tower-crane wind-speed display system, confirming the sensor+display operational pattern.

legal_basis.general: 작업자가 기상 불안정으로 위험해질 우려가 있는 경우 작업중지
legal_basis.caution: These numeric thresholds apply to tower-crane operations in the cited rule and must not be copied as universal gangform/general-lifting limits.

render_contract.composition: one compact wind-monitoring set: three-cup sensor on a short galvanized mounting mast/bracket plus separate rugged digital display box
render_contract.sensor_body: matte black cylindrical body, three black cups, simple cap, metal bracket
render_contract.display: dark gray/black weather-resistant rectangular enclosure with bright red wind-speed numerals; no fake brand/model text
render_contract.cable: minimal cable only if visually needed; wireless family may omit a long signal cable
render_contract.structure: small mast/base fragment only, not a full tower crane
render_contract.text: numerals only; no Korean labels or brand names
render_contract.camera: three-quarter product/scene-fragment view showing both sensor and monitor

reject: airport weather station with wind vane tower
displaying tower-crane 10/15 m/s values as if they were universal site limits

hard_stop: If a visual family is still site-specific/unresolved, request or search a Korean reference before calling image generation.
